entries.text:
You hail from a [settlementsize] [settlementattribute] [settlementtype], located [proximity] a [notable] [landmark], known mainly for being the [pastevent] of a [thingorevent], [playersrelationship]. In recent years, this place has fallen under the influence of wealthy traders from the north, seeking to exploit the local fauna that can be brewed into a potion used to control fierce beasts for arena fights.

The kingdom in which you once resided was ruled by a cabal of evil wizards. They use vile scheming to oppress the people, but were able to stay in power due to deals with extra-planar creatures. Your people where humble riverfolk, with close ties to the old gods and a rich bardic tradition.

To the North, vast armies of polar-bear riding gnolls threaten your people's boarders. To the East, an unknown city of automata dominates the barren planes To the South, the steaming jungles nurture the Lizardmen who covet only gold To the West, a corrupt aristocracy ruled by fear of the kings dark stormtroopers is discovering new technologies as it prepares for war.
